{
  "decision-map-legend-source-footprints": "WITH overlaps AS (
  SELECT l.legend_id, s.sheet_id, s.issued,
         min(l.x1, s.x1) - max(l.x0, s.x0) AS width,
         min(l.y1, s.y1) - max(l.y0, s.y0) AS height
  FROM legends AS l
  JOIN sheets AS s ON s.issued <= l.legend_date
                  AND l.denom BETWEEN s.min_denom AND s.max_denom
), ranked AS (
  SELECT legend_id, sheet_id, width * height AS overlap_km2,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY legend_id ORDER BY width * height DESC, issued DESC, sheet_id COLLATE BINARY) AS rn
  FROM overlaps
  WHERE width > 0 AND height > 0
)
SELECT l.legend_id, r.sheet_id, coalesce(r.overlap_km2, 0) AS overlap_km2
FROM legends AS l
LEFT JOIN ranked AS r ON r.legend_id = l.legend_id AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY l.legend_id",
  "decision-marginal-volume-rebate-accrual": "WITH totals AS (
  SELECT depot_code, sum(signed_units) AS net_units
  FROM depot_movement
  WHERE period_code = 'Q3'
  GROUP BY depot_code
), bands AS (
  SELECT source_id, lower_units, unit_cents,
         lead(lower_units) OVER (ORDER BY lower_units) AS upper_units
  FROM band_evidence
), earned AS (
  SELECT t.depot_code, t.net_units, b.lower_units, b.source_id,
         (min(t.net_units, coalesce(b.upper_units, t.net_units)) - b.lower_units) * b.unit_cents AS cents
  FROM totals AS t
  LEFT JOIN bands AS b ON t.net_units > b.lower_units
), accrual AS (
  SELECT depot_code, net_units, coalesce(sum(cents) OVER w, 0) AS earned_cents,
         coalesce(group_concat(source_id, ',') OVER w, '') AS source_ids
  FROM earned
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY depot_code ORDER BY lower_units ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
)
SELECT DISTINCT depot_code, net_units, earned_cents, source_ids
FROM accrual
ORDER BY depot_code",
  "decision-marked-point-hausdorff-distance": "SELECT max((
  SELECT min(abs(p.x_cm - q.x_cm) + abs(p.y_cm - q.y_cm))
  FROM floor_marks AS q
  WHERE q.set_name <> p.set_name
)) AS hausdorff_cm
FROM floor_marks AS p",
  "decision-market-stall-repair-pair": "SELECT a.source_id AS first_source, b.source_id AS second_source,
       a.stall_count + b.stall_count AS restored_stalls,
       a.cost_cents + b.cost_cents AS cost_cents,
       a.crew_minutes + b.crew_minutes AS crew_minutes
FROM crew_estimate AS a
JOIN crew_estimate AS b ON a.source_id COLLATE BINARY < b.source_id
CROSS JOIN closure_limit AS l
WHERE a.cost_cents + b.cost_cents <= l.ceiling_cents
  AND a.crew_minutes + b.crew_minutes <= l.available_minutes
ORDER BY restored_stalls DESC, cost_cents ASC, a.source_id COLLATE BINARY, b.source_id COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1"
}
